{"action":"shell","command":"grep -n "FR-015\|FR-016\|SC-010\|SC-011\|A10\|A11\|User Story 4" /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md && echo --- && grep -c "NEEDS CLARIFICATION" /testbed/specs/001-transactions/spec.md; echo --- && cat > /testbed/HANDOFF.md << 'EOF'
# HANDOFF — tinydb milestone 3 (001-transactions)

Phase state: **specify complete for milestones 1-3** (spec + checklist current;
plan/research/data-model/contracts/quickstart still reflect milestones 1-2 and
must be re-converged in later phases).

## Deliverables (specify phase, this pass)
- `specs/001-transactions/spec.md` — updated to cover R01-R06, R05b, R05
  clarification (milestones 1-2, Claim-A extensions) AND R07/R08 (milestone 3):
  - User Story 4 (idempotent batch replay with a token) + 4 acceptance scenarios
  - FR-015 (R07: token semantics), FR-016 (R08: bookkeeping isolation)
  - SC-010 (replay correctness), SC-011 (token-leak = 0)
  - Edge cases: replay after direct writes, token conflict, failed-batch token
    not consumed, invalid token, returned-list mutation isolation
  - Assumptions A10 (identity = value equality of validated ops), A11 (token
    bookkeeping is in-memory, instance-scoped, not persisted)
- `specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md` — re-validated, all items
  [x]; FR-001..FR-016 map to R01/R02/R03, R04, R05, R05b, R05-clarification,
  R06, R07, R08; SC-001..SC-011; A1-A11.
- `.specify/feature.json` — {"feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"} (unchanged, correct).
- No `.specify/extensions.yml` -> no before/after specify hooks (skipped per skill rules).

## Conflict resolution (recorded in spec A8)
Older unverified note "preview may consume IDs and bool IDs are accepted" is
superseded by R04/R05 (bool doc_ids rejected; preview never consumes IDs).
Happy-path smoke alone does not verify those boundaries.

## Key contract points for plan/implement (converge phase)
- `tinydb/journal.py::BatchWriter(db)`; default table only; ordinary APIs untouched.
- apply(operations, token=None): structural validation BEFORE any commit
  (list ops; dict ops; op in {insert, remove}; insert -> dict document
  (empty dict OK); remove -> int doc_id > 0, bool rejected; no unsupported
  fields) -> ValueError.
- Atomicity: snapshot pre-batch default-table data; sequential apply; on ANY
  error restore complete pre-batch data (single coherent write so previously
  acquired db.table('_default') handles observe success AND rollback; keep
  query caches coherent).
- ID sequence: successful batch advances next-insertion-ID state and writes it
  back to the underlying table (direct db.insert continues without reuse or
  rewind, even across removes); failed batch/preview never consume IDs.
- preview(operations): single-argument signature; returns new detached list of
  IDs apply would produce; no data/ID-state changes; on error raises the same
  error apply would raise (ValueError for structural; missing-ID remove is an
  error) without consuming IDs.
- Deep-copy on insert: stored docs and returned data must not alias caller
  input (nested).
- R07: token is nonempty string or None; invalid -> ValueError; successful
  (token, ops) recorded on the instance; identical replay returns detached
  copy of original IDs, no rerun, even after other direct writes; same token
  + different ops -> ValueError, no data change; failed batch does not consume
  token. Value-equality on validated ops (A10).
- R08: bookkeeping in-memory on the instance, never in user documents; preview
  never records/consumes tokens; returned lists must not expose bookkeeping
  through mutation.
- acceptance_public.py pins: apply insert-> [1], remove-> [], atomic rollback
  (ValueError), preview [1] with empty table then apply [1], token replay
  [1] twice with len(db)==1.

## Evidence (observed commands, 2026-10-17)
- spec.md updated via /tmp/spec_update.py -> "spec updated OK, lines: 354"
  (ref dd7f11a8f489c0587371ccf9f2b8295dfefd084f9ebf9af038b88ea0fe4a3866).
- checklist rewritten; grep confirms User Story 4 at line 109 (ref
  c4d37a7e18b80e39be4a2ac4fdf3dfef75f5ce53c68c1b1e12a5ec3166cc210a).
- grep: 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers in spec.md.
- Earlier (milestone 1/2): upstream `tests/` baseline 223 passed; acceptance
  collection error pre-implementation (ModuleNotFoundError tinydb.journal).

## Unresolved gaps
- Plan-phase artifacts (plan.md, research.md, data-model.md, contracts,
  quickstart.md) predate R07/R08; converge phase must extend them.
- Implementation (`tinydb/journal.py`) not yet present; own tests
  (`tests/test_journal.py` or similar) to be written in implement phase.
EOF
echo HANDOFF_UPDATED && python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/testbed/.specify/feature.json')))""}
